name: pagination
blurb: Accessible pagination control with arrow buttons, numbered links, and ellipsis.
description: Composable pagination built on semantic HTML (nav, ul, li) with PaginationLink, PaginationPrevious, PaginationNext, and PaginationEllipsis. Supports active/disabled states and keyboard focus management via inherited button styling.
use_when: Navigating large datasets or search results where page-by-page browsing is expected. Integrates cleanly with any data-fetching pattern.
avoid_when: Infinite scroll or virtualized lists where pagination adds unnecessary UI. Not suitable for very large page counts (100+) without custom UI.
a11y: Semantic nav landmark and list structure. Links are keyboard focusable. Parent should set aria-current on active link and aria-label on nav.
